test_pairwise_iou_rotated: test pairwise_iou_rotated to compute intersection over union between two sets of rotated bounding boxes on CPU or CUDA
test_RotatedBoxes_clip: test RotatedBoxes clip method to clip rotated bounding boxes to a given image size with an optional angle threshold
test_RotatedBoxes_normalize_angles: test RotatedBoxes normalize_angles method to normalize rotation angles to the range of negative 180 to 180 degrees
test_pairwise_iou_structure: test pairwise_iou function to compute pairwise intersection over union between two RotatedBoxes objects on CPU or CUDA
benchmark_rotated_iou: benchmark the pairwise_iou_rotated function performance on CPU and CUDA devices with configurable box counts
